results.summary: This design implements a simple 2-to-1 multiplexer that selects between two input signals based on a select line and drives an LED output. It is intended as a teaching example for the Tiny Tapeout Teardown 2026 workshop, demonstrating basic digital logic on a Wokwi-based project. The design uses three input pins: two data inputs and one select input, with the output connected to an LED. No external hardware is required beyond the standard Tiny Tapeout demo board, and the documentation is minimal, consisting only of placeholder text.
